title: 第7章 五等资质
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
伊森摇头：“不知道。还请大师明示。”

    加尔深吸一口气，触腕把兜帽重新拉下，遮住那张失态的老脸。他的声音努力恢复平静，却依旧带着明显的颤抖：

    “先天精神力......98。”

    “按照巫师议会的资质划分标准，精神力10到25为一等资质，26到40为二等，41到55为三等，56到75为四等，76以上......为五等。”

    他顿了顿，触腕指着水晶球上那个依旧泛着微光的数字：

    “你是五等资质。先天精神力98的五等资质。”

    伊森沉默了一秒。

    “这个资质......很高？”

    “很高？”

    加尔的声音骤然拔高，尖锐得破了音，几只触腕同时挥舞起来，带起呼呼风声：

    “很高？这叫很高？我在这穷乡僻壤的次生大陆的这屁大点的帝国七十年了，你知道一共出过几个先天精神力超过55的吗？”

    他不需要伊森回答，自己就咬牙切齿地给出了答案：

    “一个都没有！”

    激动过后，加尔的情绪猛地低落下去，“七十年，我守着这座塔七十年，测试过的孩子没有十万也有八万。最高纪录是多少你知道吗？”

    他不需要伊森回答，触腕猛地探出，卷起石台上那只新茶杯，狠狠灌了一口。

    “五十三。”加尔的声音沙哑，“一个先天精神力五十三的小丫头。三等资质，勉勉强强。后来呢？后来她卡在二等巫师学徒二十年，最后嫁给了本地一个小贵族，生了三个孩子，如今坟头草都该有我高了。”

    “至于五等资质...”加尔顿了顿，“我这辈子没见过。你们这个有着7000万人口的小小帝国，也没出现过。”

    伊森沉默了几秒，缓缓开口：“那现在，有了。”

    加尔愣了一秒。

    随即，那张苍老的脸上绽开一个近乎癫狂的笑容。

    “哈哈哈，是啊，有了啊。”

    他猛地站起身，墨绿罩袍下摆翻涌，几只触腕同时探出，在空中毫无章法地挥舞，仿佛在宣泄某种积压了数十年的情绪。

    “七十年......七十年了！”加尔的声音变得沙哑而激动，“我这辈子守着这个破地方，测试了八万多个孩子，一个四等都没有，更别说五等！结果今天，就在今天......”
content_en:
Ethan shook his head: "I don't know. Please let me know, Master."

    Gal took a deep breath, touched his wrist and pulled down his hood again, covering his gloomy old face. His voice tried to regain its calmness, but it still had an obvious tremor:

    "Innate spiritual power...98."

    "According to the Wizards Council's qualification classification standards, mental strength of 10 to 25 is the first level, 26 to 40 is the second level, 41 to 55 is the third level, 56 to 75 is the fourth level, and above 76...is the fifth level."

    He paused, then touched his wrist and pointed at the number on the crystal ball that was still glowing:

    "You have fifth-level qualifications. Fifth-level qualifications with innate mental power of 98."

    Ethan was silent for a second.

    "This qualification...is very high?"

    "Very high?"

    Gal's voice suddenly rose to a pitch that was so sharp that it broke. Several tentacles waved at the same time, causing a whirring sound:

    "Very high? Is this called very high? I have been in this big empire in this remote secondary continent for seventy years. Do you know how many people with innate mental power of over 55 have been produced?"

    He didn't need Ethan to answer, so he gritted his teeth and gave the answer:

    "Not one!"

    After the excitement, Gal's mood suddenly dropped, "Seventy years, I have guarded this tower for seventy years, and the number of children I have tested is not one hundred thousand but eighty thousand. Do you know what the highest record is?"

    He didn't need Ethan to answer, so he stretched out his wrist, rolled up the new teacup on the stone table, and took a deep sip.

    "Fifty-three." Gal's voice was hoarse. "A little girl with an innate mental strength of fifty-three. Third-class qualifications, barely enough. What happened next? Then she was stuck as a second-class wizard apprentice for twenty years, and finally married a local nobleman and gave birth to three children. Now she should be as tall as me."

    "As for fifth-level qualifications..." Gal paused, "I have never seen one in my life. Even in your small empire with a population of 70 million, it has never appeared before."

    Ethan was silent for a few seconds and then slowly said: "Now, I have it."

    Gal was stunned for a second.

    Immediately, an almost crazy smile broke out on that old face.

    "Hahaha, yes, I have it."

    He stood up abruptly, the hem of his dark green robe billowed out, and several tentacles were thrust out at the same time, waving in the air in an orderly manner, as if he was venting some emotions that had been accumulated for decades.

    "Seventy years...seventy years!" Gal's voice became hoarse and excited. "I have guarded this wretched place all my life and tested more than 80,000 children, and not a single one was fourth grade, let alone fifth grade! As a result, today, just today..."
